title: B5 evidence digests line-ending dependent; strict B5 verification skipped on Linux CI
evidence: Round-3 re-check @ audit_execution_sha ee5470f5 on TES' b5c2481d. Round-1 defect re-tested. New tree qualification_at_62d1c615855a3eaf569777a10e342aacc889a128 (commit 163ef0c0): .gitattributes marks it -text (git check-attr: 'text: unset'; git ls-files --eol: i/crlf w/crlf for 7 files and i/lf w/lf for the index, identical in an autocrlf=false worktree and an autocrlf=true worktree). sha256 of every file of the tree equals (a) publication_index.v1.json, (b) evidence_manifest.v1.json, (c) the git blob bytes at 163ef0c0 (probes/modeA_probe.py A01). verify_b5_publication_tree = () (no errors) in the autocrlf=false worktree (A00c), in the autocrlf=true worktree (A00b), on a copy of the worktree bytes (A00) and on git-blob bytes (A01). Tamper cases A02-A15, A19, A21, A22 rejected; wrong pin (A08), non-ancestor SHA (A09), nonexistent SHA (A07), missing file (A04), missing index (A05), altered digest (A06) rejected. Linux CI: push run 42522213144 on fb48714de065166bf5aed558183c76074573b808 ran the ladder-pinned strict test: 311 passed, 92 skipped, the two 'no strictly valid B5 tree' skips of run 42490370822 are gone. Legacy 89c76eb7 tree: still LF-blob/CRLF-digest, 8 digest errors on an LF checkout (A00d), 0 on a CRLF checkout (A00e); the waiver exists only in test_ladder_pinned_b5_tree_verifies_strictly_on_every_platform and applies only while the ladder still pins 89c76eb7 (no longer the case).
recommendation: Fix by the implementer in a separate loop: mark the B5 tree `-text` (as already done for iiac_evidence) or define the digests over LF-normalised bytes, republish the tree with a new EVIDENCE_PUBLICATION_SHA, make the pinned-tree test FAIL (not skip) when the ladder-pinned tree does not verify, and add a Linux CI step that runs verify_b5_publication_tree on the pinned tree. Until then B5 integrity can be demonstrated only on an autocrlf=true Windows checkout.
